preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must have some CHC tokens to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBurnFee() and setSwapFee() with excessively high values (e.g., 99). Then perform a token transfer to/from the swapAddress to trigger the fee mechanism, causing disproportionate token burns and liquidity fees that benefit the owner-controlled addresses (deadWallet and liquidityAddress). The high fees effectively steal value from users during transfers.
